name: agent-be-hono
description: Rules, a reviewer and checks for Bun + Hono + Drizzle APIs in Claude Code, on top of agent-core. Hook: migration-guard refuses hand edits to generated Drizzle migrations (folders in .claude/agent-config.json; a repo without one is unaffected). Commands: setup and sync install and verify the backend and TypeScript rules, anti-patterns, quality-gate check scripts (migrations, index coverage, coverage policy, module mocks, constants), lint and test config, and a pull-request-only CI caller. Agent: reviewer. The hook runs on your machine, opens no network connection and stays silent until the project opts in.
